name: Sage of Fables
oracle_text:
Each other Wizard creature you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
{2}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control: Draw a card.
blocked_sentences: {2}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control: Draw a card.

needs.what: an activated-ability cost that removes N counters of a NAMED kind (here one +1/+1 counter) from a permanent the payer chooses among a selector (here 'a creature you control'), not just from the source -- e.g. remove_counters_from_among accepting a 'counter' kind, or remove_counters accepting an 'objects' selector
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cost.remove_counters takes a named kind but only ever removes from the source; cost.remove_counters_from_among chooses among other permanents but removes counters of any kind, and the loader explicitly refuses a 'counter' key on it. Filtering its pool with has_counters: '+1/+1' still lets the payer remove a different kind (e.g. -1/-1) from a creature carrying both, so it would be a strictly cheaper card
